description: This file contains functions for fetching calendar events with timezone normalization, handling multiple calendar providers, decryption of credentials, and filtering calendars based on CalDAV server URLs. It is specific to calendar event retrieval and credential management within a calendar integration feature.

methods.name: getCalendarsEventsWithTimezones
methods.description: Fetches calendar events with timezone normalization for multiple credentials and calendars, supporting fallback logic for delegation credentials.

methods.name: getCalendarsEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events for multiple credentials and calendars, decrypting credentials if necessary, with performance measurement and logging.

methods.name: getServerUrlFromCalendarExternalId
methods.description: Extracts server URL from a CalDAV calendar externalId.

methods.name: getServerUrlFromCredential
methods.description: Extracts server URL from a CalDAV credential after decrypting its secret.

methods.name: filterSelectedCalendarsForCredential
methods.description: Filters selected calendars to match the server URL of a given CalDAV credential.
